PLAN "Prenatal Strength — 12 Week Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength safely through pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 — Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          cat_cow 1m
          bird_dog 1m
          hip_circles 1m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          child_pose 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          arm_circles 1m
          scapular_retraction 1m
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          leg_swings 1m
          cat_cow 1m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

          diaphragmatic_breathing 3m
          figure_four_stretch 1m
